## Codex Code Review (gpt-5.6-sol, high)
<!-- OpenAI Codex via RPR -->

### High [2]

#### 1. Exact-catalog billing charges unpriced cache modalities at the text-cache rate

In `services/api/internal/service/billing_service.go:511-526,591`, audio and image cache reads are recorded as unpriced, while `cacheReadCost` is calculated from the full `CacheReadTokens` aggregate. For example, 100 image-cache tokens with a configured text-cache price are logged as unpriced and still charged at that text-cache price. When modality details exceed the aggregate, this path also succeeds instead of returning the contradiction error promised by the PR contract.

Compute `cacheReadTextTokens` by subtracting audio and image cache tokens, reject a negative result, and apply `prices.cacheRead` only to the remaining text-cache tokens. Add exact-catalog tests for a valid modality split and details exceeding the aggregate.

Origin: Introduced by this PR

#### 2. The required DeepSeek production prices remain unset

The complete diff contains no pricing-data update; `services/api/internal/service/billing_service.go:281-287` only warns and charges missing components at zero. Consequently, rows 147–150 continue billing every cache read at zero after this PR merges. This leaves the known production underbilling described by TXE-4531 unresolved and fails R4.

Apply the user-provided cache-read prices to production rows 147–150 through the repository’s auditable data-update mechanism, and verify the stored values before closing the ticket.

Origin: Pre-existing

### Medium [1]

#### 1. Exact-catalog warnings omit missing cache-creation subcomponents

In `services/api/internal/service/billing_service.go:620-622`, `cache_creation` is reported only when the aggregate is positive and every cache-creation price is absent. With cache breakdown enabled, a template containing a 5-minute price and no generic or 1-hour price will bill used 1-hour tokens at zero without logging any unpriced component because one unrelated price is present.

Determine the effective price for each used 5-minute and 1-hour component, including the generic-price fallback used by `exactCatalogCacheCreationCost`, and report `cache_creation_5m` or `cache_creation_1h` whenever its effective price is absent. Cover partial breakdown pricing in an exact-catalog test.

Origin: Introduced by this PR

## Codex Code Review (gpt-5.6-sol, high)
<!-- OpenAI Codex via RPR -->

### Medium [1]

#### 1. Exact-catalog image output can remain absent from the warning

In `services/api/internal/service/billing_service.go:576-585,616-625`, image-output tokens fall back to the effective output price. When both `prices.imageOutput` and the effective output price are absent, image output is billed at zero. The warning logic only checks `textOutputTokens`, so an image-only request succeeds without naming `image_output`; a mixed request names `output` while still omitting the separately unpriced image-output component. This violates R1’s requirement that the warning name the unpriced components.

Append `image_output` when `ImageOutputTokens > 0` and neither the image-output price nor the effective base/priority output fallback is present. Add exact-catalog coverage for image-only and mixed-output usage.

Origin: Pre-existing
